name: brew-search
title: Brew Packages
description: Search Homebrew formulae and casks on an atomic Linux host and install the selected package.
author: HuntedRaven7

commands.name: packages
commands.title: Search Brew Packages
commands.description: Search formulae and casks and install the selection with Homebrew.

preferences.name: brewPath
preferences.title: Homebrew executable
preferences.description: Path to brew on the host, used for installs. Searches use the formulae.brew.sh API because the worker cannot execute Linuxbrew. Bluefin usually uses /home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin/brew.

preferences.name: includeFormulae
preferences.title: Package types
preferences.label: Formulae
preferences.description: Include command-line formulae in search results.

preferences.name: includeCasks
preferences.label: Casks
preferences.description: Include desktop casks in search results.
